## Plugins are someone else's code

**CLAP plugins never run inside Jämmer.** Each one runs in a small helper program of its own, which can't reach the network, can't write files and, of your files, can read only the plugin folders. If a CLAP plugin crashes or stops answering:

- the track plays on without it, still in time with the others,
- the status bar tells you which plugin it was,
- the plugin is switched off, so it isn't started again by accident. **Track › Plugins…** lists it with a **Switch On** button for when you want to try again,
- your document is untouched.

Jämmer finds CLAP plugins in `~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP` and `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP` when it starts; **Scan for CLAP Plugins** looks again. Each plugin is looked at in a helper program too, so one that crashes or hangs while it's loaded is just listed as unusable. At most 64 CLAP plugins run at the same time.

Because of the confinement, a CLAP plugin that needs to read its own licence or preset files from elsewhere on your disk, or to go online, may not work here.

**Audio Units run inside Jämmer**, and a badly behaved one can crash the app. If that happens, turn on **Safe mode** at the bottom of **Track › Plugins…**: every Audio Unit then runs in macOS's separate plugin host process instead, which is meant to keep one that crashes from taking Jämmer with it.
clap.off:
## Plugins are someone else's code

A plugin runs inside Jämmer, and a badly behaved one can crash the app. If that happens, turn on **Safe mode** at the bottom of **Track › Plugins…**: every Audio Unit then runs in macOS's separate plugin host process instead, which is meant to keep one that crashes from taking Jämmer with it.

clap.on: Yes: Audio Unit effects (AUv2 and AUv3) and CLAP plugins can be put on any track. A CLAP plugin runs in a helper program of its own, never inside Jämmer, so one that crashes only goes quiet: its track plays on without it and Jämmer tells you. Audio Units run inside Jämmer; with **Safe mode** on (Track › Plugins…) they run in macOS's separate plugin host process instead. VST plugins aren't supported yet.
clap.off: Yes: Audio Unit effects (AUv2 and AUv3) can be put on any track. They run inside Jämmer; with **Safe mode** on (Track › Plugins…) they run in macOS's separate plugin host process instead. CLAP and VST plugins aren't supported yet.
